means: for every corpus round whose bag 1 is shiwehi.com's 山岳積み2号 bag 1 cell for cell (as drawn or mirrored, the L stood on end at 7 locks or held at 6), the deepest node of that page's route tree the round reaches, and how often each node's sampling point was reached
not_eligible_because: every board is the vendored Triangle engine's; which bag-2 and later shape was built has no second implementation. The Perfect Clear COUNT is anchored by perfect_clear_timing, the shape is not.
caveat: bag-1 opportunities count rounds that reached the sampling point clean (inside the verified prefix, no clear, no garbage before it); bag-2 and snapshot opportunities allow garbage: complete garbage rows are stripped from the bottom of the board first (garbage_rows_stripped), so they count rounds inside the verified prefix with no line cleared by the player before the sample. PC patterns have no separate sampling point and count the rounds that reached their anchor: the bag-1 L-held board for the 4-line PCs, the bag-2 group for the rest (2.compromise for the 5-bag line, whose own bag-3 and bag-4 boards are a 9-row group). A hold is asserted only by the lock-7 piece test. The page's order readings (%S%O, %O%S) are ours. bag2_near is measured against the board before the TST, never a match.

rules.bag2_garbage: strip complete garbage rows from the bottom

pc_kinds.frame_after: the last TSD before the PC

rules.precedence: l_top (7 locks); only if it misses, l_hold (6 locks) split by the lock-7 piece against the mirror-aware bag-1 L
rules.condition_handedness: a mirrored round's bag-2 order is read with J<->L and S<->Z swapped
rules.group_scope: the three 2.normal forms share one PC list: PC patterns are scoped by their anchor, the form's group
rules.bag2_near: a bag-1 round with no bag-2 match: the board before its TST, by occupancy, against every bag-2 board: a strict subset (the TST before the board was complete), that board plus exactly four cells, or that board with one piece's four cells moved elsewhere
